question.name: Question 1
question.problem:
Suppose $n=6p-14,$ where $p\in Z.$ Complete the following argument showing that $n$ is even.

The number $n$ is even since 

$$
\begin{aligned}n & =6p-14 \\  & =2({{field-1}}) \\  & ={{field-2}},\end{aligned}
$$

where we have defined $a=$ {{field-3}}, which is an integer.
